title: Derived residue pullback of a supplied affine K-flat module model
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], E in its derived category [def-pc-derived-category], U an affine open, A=Gamma(U,O_X), and F a K-flat A-module cochain complex [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Assume E restricted to the localized site of U is isomorphic to Q of termwise affinePerfectSheafification F [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model]. For z in U set p=hU.isoSpec.hom z. Let e:kappa_X(z) -> kappa(p) be the field isomorphism obtained by composing the residue map of U.ι, the inverse residue map of hU.isoSpec.hom, and Spec.residueFieldIso A p. Then the derived residue pullback Li_z^* E is isomorphic to Q of termwise tilde over kappa_X(z) of restrictScalars e applied termwise to F tensor_A kappa(p). This is an isomorphism of derived sheaf objects, without taking cohomology or dimensions; F need not be bounded or free.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories of Schemes

proof.text: Factor the residue point through U using the inverse of its residue-field map. Residue-point naturality and Spec.map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField identify g followed by the affine chart with Spec.map of the composite A -> kappa(p) -> kappa_X(z), where the second map is e.inv. These are equalities of the actual morphisms, not identifications through an unspecified equivalence.

Termwise tilde F is K-flat by lem-pc-affine-tilde-kflat, after converting the categorical module K-flat predicate using the proved homotopy-category acyclicity criterion. Pull it back along the chart using lem-pc-kflat-pullback-preservation. The chart restriction functor is naturally isomorphic to tensor pullback by the two adjunctions. Cancel the canonical over-site equivalence and its inverse in affinePerfectSheafification. Mapping these natural isomorphisms to complexes transports K-flatness to the supplied local model. Transport K-flatness through the existing private Scheme.Modules.kFlat_of_iso from FlatModelFiniteFreeComparison, imported for the proof with import all; do not redeclare it.

Apply lem-sc-local-kflat-pullback-model to the supplied model and the factored residue point. This computes the ambient derived pullback as Q of ordinary pullback of the transported complex on U, with no chosen derived affine equivalence and no new boundedness assumption.

Compose ordinary pullbacks along g and the affine chart and apply the natural tilde/base-change comparison lem-weil-pbc-tilde-pullback-base-change to the identified spectrum morphism. Extension of scalars along e.inv is naturally isomorphic to restriction along e.hom: both are left adjoint to restriction along e.inv, using the module equivalence of a ring isomorphism. The scalar-extension composition isomorphism therefore rewrites extension along A -> kappa_X(z) as extension to kappa(p) followed by restriction along e.hom. Lift the resulting natural isomorphism degreewise to complexes, map it with Q, and compose with the local-model isomorphism.

theorem affine_kFlat_residuePullback_model (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    [∀ x : X, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (X.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))) ℤ)
    (hF : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso
      (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))) (.up ℤ)).kFlat F)
    (hmodel : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj F)))
    (z : U) :
    let e := asIso (U.ι.residueFieldMap z) ≪≫
      (asIso (hU.isoSpec.hom.residueFieldMap z)).symm ≪≫
        Spec.residueFieldIso (X.presheaf.obj (.op U)) (hU.isoSpec.hom z)
    Nonempty ((derivedPullback (X.fromSpecResidueField z)).obj E ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((tilde.functor (X.residueField z)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars e.hom.hom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            (((ModuleCat.extendScalars
              (algebraMap (X.presheaf.obj (.op U))
                (hU.isoSpec.hom z).asIdeal.ResidueField)).mapHomologicalComplex
                  (.up ℤ)).obj F))))
